zh.name: 易创
zh.brief: 纯本地优先的开源 AI 网文写作软件：小说创作、BYOK 直连 AI、自定义提示词
zh.description:
易创（easy-writing）是开源 AGPL-3.0 的本地优先 AI 网文写作软件，由长期线上运营的写作平台客户端改造而来。

原项目功能：TipTap 富文本写作台，卷/章目录树、边写边存、每章自动保留历史版本；书架多作品管理（分组/封面/TXT·JSON 导入导出/回收站）；参考资料五件套（大纲、角色关系图、设定、时间线、故事线）；码字统计与灵感速记；AI 辅助支持 BYOK 直连 DeepSeek、通义千问、智谱、OpenRouter 等 OpenAI 兼容渠道及本地 Ollama，提供划词润色、流式续写、妙笔对话、工作流一键建书、AI 封面与取名器。

懒猫版新增：网页端开箱即用，数据按浏览器隔离存储；导出/导入接入懒猫网盘（保存到懒猫网盘、从懒猫网盘打开，按微服用户隔离）；源码按 AGPL-3.0 开源于 fork 仓库（见来源链接）；BYOK 密钥仅保存在浏览器本地，服务端转发不落盘。
zh.changelog: 按审核反馈整改：移除榜单风向功能；源码按上游 AGPL-3.0 要求开源于 fork 仓库。同时保留上游 v1.0.6 全量写作功能与懒猫网盘文件拦截（导入/导出）。

en.name: Easy Writing
en.brief: Open-source local-first AI novel writing app: BYOK direct AI connection, custom prompts
en.description:
Easy Writing (easy-writing) is an open-source (AGPL-3.0) local-first AI novel writing app.

Upstream features: TipTap rich-text editor with volume/chapter tree, autosave and per-chapter version history; multi-book shelf (groups, covers, TXT/JSON import-export, recycle bin); reference toolkit (outline, character relations, settings, timeline, storyline); writing statistics and idea notes; BYOK AI through OpenAI-compatible providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu, OpenRouter) and local Ollama, with selection polish, streaming continuation, AI chat, one-click book workflow and cover generation.

LazyCat edition: works out of the box in the browser with per-user isolated data; import/export integrated with LazyCat Drive (save to / open from LazyCat Drive, isolated per microserver user); modified source is open-sourced under AGPL-3.0 in the fork repository (see source link); BYOK keys stay in browser local storage only.
en.changelog: Compliance update per review feedback: removed the rank-tracking feature; modified source open-sourced under upstream AGPL-3.0 in the fork repository. All upstream v1.0.6 writing features and LazyCat Drive file interception (import/export) remain.
